service.method: SELECT USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.PLANT_CODE , USMT.DEPT , USMT.POSITION , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.USER_NAME_ENG , USMT.SIGN_STATUS , USMT.USER_TYPE , USMT.WORK_TYPE , ADDR.EMAIL , USMT.STATE , USMT.THEME , USMT.COUNTRY , USMT.TIME_ZONE , USMT.LANGUAGE , USMT.DATE_FORMAT , USMT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC , ADDR.PHONE_NO1 , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 , ADDR.ZIP_CODE , ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC , ADDR.ADDRESS_ENG FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND ADDR.CODE_TYPE = 'USER' LEFT OUTER JOIN SBAGL BAGL ON USMT.CTRL_CODE = BAGL.CTRL_CODE AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = BAGL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = BAGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE USMT.USER_ID = ${USER_ID} AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
